app.offline: You're offline. You can still report a leak; we'll send it when you're back online.
app.installHint: Add Flow to your home screen to report leaks faster.

statusHelp.in_progress: The crew is working on it

home.title: Seen a water leak?
home.lead: Tell the water company in under a minute. We'll keep you posted until it's fixed.
home.step1: Take a photo of the leak.
home.step2: Check the pin is in the right place.
home.step3: Answer two quick questions and send. You get a reference number.
home.draft: You have a report you didn't finish.
home.waiting_one: {{count}} report is waiting to send. It will go when you're online.
home.waiting_other: {{count}} reports are waiting to send. They will go when you're online.
home.trackHint: Enter the reference number you were given.

report.title: Report a leak
report.outboxSent_one: Your saved report has been sent.

photo.title: Take a photo of the leak
photo.lead: A photo helps the crew find it and know what to bring.
photo.error: We couldn't use that photo. Try taking it again.
photo.notImage: That file isn't a photo. Choose a picture from your gallery.
photo.tip: Stand back so the photo shows the leak and something nearby, like a gate or sign.

location.title: Where is the leak?
location.lead: We've placed the pin where you are. Move it if the leak is somewhere else.
location.accuracy: Your location is accurate to about {{m}} m.
location.failed: We couldn't get your location. Drag the pin to where the leak is.
location.denied: Location is turned off for this site. Drag the pin to where the leak is, or allow location in your browser settings.
location.unsupported: This phone can't share its location. Drag the pin to where the leak is.
location.dragHint: Drag the pin, or tap the map, to move it.
location.outside: This spot is outside the area we cover (Nairobi). Check the pin is on the leak.
location.landmarkHint: For example: opposite Kencom bus stop.
location.confirm: The pin is on the leak
location.pinLabel: Leak location pin. Use the arrow keys to move it.

details.title: A few quick details
details.lead: Everything here is optional, but it helps the crew.
details.duration: How long has it been leaking?
details.descriptionHint: For example: water is flooding the road.
details.descriptionHintNoPhoto: As there's no photo, please describe what you see.
details.descriptionRequired: Describe the leak in a few words, as there's no photo.
details.phoneHint: We'll text you when the status changes. Leave empty if you don't want updates.
details.phoneInvalid: Enter a Kenyan mobile number, like 0712 345 678.
details.privacy: Your photo and the exact location go to the water utility. We remove other hidden information from the photo, like the camera model and time it was taken.

leakTypeHints.burst_pipe: Water gushing or spraying from a pipe
leakTypeHints.pooling: Water collecting on the ground or road
leakTypeHints.dripping: A tap, valve or meter that won't stop
leakTypeHints.sewage: Dirty water or an overflowing manhole

duplicate.title: Others have reported a leak near here
duplicate.body_one: {{type}}, about {{distance}} m away, reported {{when}} by {{count}} person.
duplicate.body_other: {{type}}, about {{distance}} m away, reported {{when}} by {{count}} people.
duplicate.why: If it's the same leak, adding your report helps it get fixed sooner.
duplicate.different: No, this is a different leak
duplicate.willJoin: Your report and photo will be added to {{ref}}.

done.title: Report sent. Thank you!
done.body: The water utility has your report.
done.joinedBody: Your report was added to the existing one. More reports help it get fixed faster.
done.sms: We'll text you each time the status changes.
done.noSms: Keep this number to check progress. Add a phone number next time to get SMS updates.
done.typical: Leaks like this are usually fixed within about {{time}}.
done.offlineBody: You're offline right now. We'll send your report as soon as you're connected again; you don't need to do anything.

track.title: Report status
track.notFound: We couldn't find report {{ref}}. Check the number and try again. It looks like FLW-7K3QPX.
track.others_one: {{count}} other person reported this leak too.
track.others_other: {{count}} other people reported this leak too.
track.invalidBody: The utility checked and couldn't find a leak to repair here.

myReports.title: My reports
myReports.signedOutLead: Sign in with your phone number to see your reports on any device.
myReports.emptyBody: When you report a leak, it will show here so you can follow it.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: We'll text you a 6-digit code. No password needed.
signIn.codeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits from the SMS.

staff.loginLead: For water utility dispatchers, technicians and admins.

dashboard.mapLabel: Map of reports. Numbers show priority. Every report on the map is also in the list.
dashboard.empty: New reports will appear here as citizens send them.
dashboard.emptyFiltered: Nothing matches these filters. Try clearing some.

priority.title: Priority and why
priority.breakdownCaption: How the priority score of {{score}} was worked out

detail.aiSays: The photo check thinks this is {{label}} ({{pct}}% sure).
detail.mergeBody: This report will be grouped with {{ref}}. Everyone who reported it will get the same updates. You can undo this.
detail.photoAltBefore: Citizen's photo of a reported {{type}}. Photo check: {{label}}.
detail.splitBody: It will become its own report again, with its own priority.
detail.invalidBody: The report will be closed and the citizen told why. You can undo this or reopen it later.
detail.overrideHint: Your change and reason are saved in the history so others can see why.
detail.reasonHint: A short note, like “flooding a clinic entrance”.
detail.reasonRequired: Add a short reason (at least 3 characters).

assign.title: Assign {{ref}}
assign.dueHint: When the repair should be done.
assign.note: The report moves to Scheduled and the citizen gets an SMS.

stats.avgFixSub_other: Based on {{count}} fixes in the last 90 days
stats.waterLostSub: Last 90 days · about {{rate}} m³ a day right now
stats.estimateNote: Water lost is an estimate from each leak's type, size and how long it was open.
stats.perAreaCaption: Reports per area in the last 30 days, with how many are still open

stats.noReports: No reports in the last 30 days.

tech.title: My jobs
tech.emptyBody: New jobs will appear here when a dispatcher assigns them to you.
tech.started: Job started. The citizen has been told.
tech.markedFixed: Marked fixed. The citizen has been told.
tech.noPhotoBody: An after photo shows the repair was done. You can still mark it fixed without one.

admin.title: Admin
admin.weightsHint: Each number is the most points that factor can add. They usually add up to 100.

weightHints.severity: Critical gets all of it, low a quarter.
weightHints.duplicates: More people reporting the same leak.
weightHints.age: Grows the longer a leak stays open.
weightHints.sensitive_site: Closer to a hospital or school scores more.
weightHints.main_pipe: Added when the leak is on a main.

params.water_loss_cap_lpd: Litres a day for full points

admin.settingsSaved: Settings saved. Scores are being updated.

admin.siteHint: Click the map where the hospital, school or other place is.
admin.siteMapLabel: Map for placing a sensitive place
admin.clickMap: Click the map to place it.
admin.removeSiteBody: {{name}} will no longer raise the priority of nearby leaks.

admin.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Share it privately.

errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

codes.rate_limited: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
codes.outside_service_area: This spot is outside the area we cover (Nairobi). Check the pin is on the leak.
codes.validation_failed: Some details need fixing. Check the highlighted fields.
codes.bad_credentials: That email and password don't match. Check them and try again.
codes.session_expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

codes.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new code.
